business_problem: With data services provided by major global platforms, retail brands can now easily and quickly analyze consumer behavior online.
solution_summary: Leverages Google Cloud to automate data cleaning and deploy its FinTech services, invos Group is able to provide more instant data insights to offline retailers while ensuring reliable, compliant data processing and storage. invos Group is set to address this pain point. Its mobile application, invos , is one of the most popular receipt storage tools in Taiwan, with more than 8.5 million member users. As collecting electronic purchase receipts is a common practice encouraged by the government's policy and a lottery-like scheme in the country, invos Group possesses a huge database of offline sales records that can generate useful insights for retail brands. Now, invos Group leverages to automatically identify products in its receipt data, resulting in higher accuracy and efficiency.

solution_components.name: Cloud SQL
solution_components.role: Stores transactional state and application data for the operational workflow at low latency.

solution_components.name: Google Kubernetes Engine (GKE)
solution_components.role: Runs containerized or virtualized application workloads with the elasticity needed for production scale.
